claims.domain: project text runtime and resumable task recovery
claims.conclusion: Project resolves ProjectContext by novel_id and its owner, then obtains a secret-free account runtime profile. Text execution snapshots omit API Key and full Base URL/extra values while recording hashes, provider/model, effective settings and capability/cost-routing snapshots. Restore validates version, novel_id and snapshot hash, rejects a legacy local_agent field, resolves the original provider for the same project owner, requires its current key, and rejects base_url or extra hash drift. Same owner/provider key rotation is supported; switching the active provider does not redirect an old snapshot. The module page documents the high-level rotation behavior but not the exact failure conditions or complete facade seam list.
